column1: # Turnover numbers and optimized copy numbers of the aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases.
# Values: Dykeman, E. (2025) An empirical model of aminoacylation kinetics for E. coli class I and II aminoacyl tRNA
# synthetases. PLoS Comput Biol. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1013353 (S1 Text, Table I): kcat (curated in vitro
# consensus) and synthetase copies per cell at growth rates of 0.41, 0.69, 1.04 and 1.73 per hour.
# The ParCa charging fit (reconstruction/ecoli/fit_trna_charging.py) uses kcat x copies as each synthetase's charging
# capacity and sets a per-synthetase effective rate constant on the model's own synthetase counts to match it, so
# expression stays as fit from RNA-seq. For reference, Dykeman's copy numbers are about 3x the model's (2.4-5.5x).
